meta.title: awesome-mad-projects
meta.thesis: Turning fictional and folk-math claims into real, tested code.

clusters.title: Infinity & Geometry — the infinity-lab monorepo
clusters.blurb: A Python monorepo that treats infinity, curvature, and compactification as objects you can compute with.

projects.name: Gojo's Infinity
projects.tagline: Gojo Satoru's "Infinity" examined through four independent mathematical lenses — can an attacker ever reach him?

projects.name: Möbius Rickness
projects.tagline: The Central Finite Curve as a real zero set — a Rick & Morty conceit turned into honest differential geometry.

projects.name: Central Finite Curve
projects.tagline: An infinite-but-bounded region of the multiverse, carved out as a src-layout geometry package.

projects.name: Calabi–Yau Latent Space
projects.tagline: A latent space with large extended dimensions and compactified periodic ones — a toy Calabi–Yau compactification.

projects.name: Domain Expansion
projects.tagline: Domain Expansion as a coupled constraint solver: power is the stability and well-posedness of the constraint system.

clusters.title: Math in code
clusters.blurb: Standalone prototypes where a real theorem or metric does the work.

projects.name: Divergence Meter
projects.tagline: A Steins;Gate worldline-divergence number, classified into an attractor field and rendered on a nixie-tube display.

projects.name: p-adic Embeddings
projects.tagline: An embedding space whose geometry is governed by the p-adic metric instead of the usual Euclidean one.

projects.name: Madoka Entropy
projects.tagline: A closed system of magical girls, a global entropy budget, and the incubators who harvest the difference.

projects.name: Surreal Priority
projects.tagline: Conway's surreal numbers as process priorities, driving a deterministic scheduler simulation.

projects.name: Stat-Mech Scheduler
projects.tagline: A simulation-only CPU scheduler that treats tasks as particles with energy and the system as having a temperature.

projects.name: Hairy Ball Router
projects.tagline: Routes packets across the sphere S² by following a continuous tangent vector field — the Hairy Ball Theorem, live.

projects.name: Banach–Tarski Duplicator
projects.tagline: The combinatorial heart of the Banach–Tarski paradox on the free group F2, constructively and exactly.

projects.name: Zeno Protocol
projects.tagline: Delivers a message by moving half the remaining distance every tick — transport built on Zeno's dichotomy paradox.

projects.name: Infinite Hotel Scheduler
projects.tagline: Hilbert's Infinite Hotel as a cloud scheduler — a resource allocator that is never full.

projects.name: Category API
projects.tagline: An HTTP/handler layer modeled as a category, with the relevant laws actually enforced by property-based tests.

projects.name: Reading Steiner Git
projects.tagline: A Steins;Gate worldline VCS toy that snapshots a sandbox and reports a six-decimal Divergence Meter reading.

clusters.title: Systems & anime (safe userspace)
clusters.blurb: OS-flavored prototypes that stay entirely inside a sandbox they create and own.

projects.name: Death Note
projects.tagline: A safe, sandboxed process reaper: write a name into a /dev/deathnote-style CLI and the named target dies.

projects.name: JoJo Stands
projects.tagline: A tick-based OS-scheduler simulation whose in-memory processes are granted JoJo Stand abilities.

projects.name: Unlimited Void
projects.tagline: Gojo's Unlimited Void modeled as a container-runtime primitive over a simulated process table.

projects.name: AT Field
projects.tagline: Process isolation modeled as an Evangelion AT Field — the boundary that keeps one process distinct and inviolable.

projects.name: Equivalent Exchange FS
projects.tagline: A filesystem enforcing the Law of Equivalent Exchange: to obtain, something of equal value must be lost.

projects.name: Vanguard Anti-Cheat
projects.tagline: The honest subset of a game anti-cheat, entirely in safe userspace over a sandbox it creates and owns.
